description: This header file declares the interface class IFactories within the WPEFramework::PluginHost namespace. The class provides static and virtual methods related to creating proxy objects for web requests, responses, file bodies, and JSON RPC messages, serving as a factory interface for web-related components in the plugin host framework.

classes.name: IFactories
classes.description: An interface providing factory methods for creating web request/response and JSON RPC message objects, with static management functions to access the singleton instance and check availability.

methods.name: ~IFactories
methods.description: Virtual destructor for the IFactories interface.

methods.name: Assign
methods.description: Sets the singleton instance of IFactories.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of IFactories.

methods.name: IsAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the IFactories instance is available.

methods.name: Request
methods.description: Pure virtual function to create a Web::Request proxy object.

methods.name: Response
methods.description: Pure virtual function to create a Web::Response proxy object.

methods.name: FileBody
methods.description: Pure virtual function to create a Web::FileBody proxy object.

methods.name: JSONRPC
methods.description: Pure virtual function to create a Web::JSONBodyType<Core::JSONRPC::Message> proxy object.
